# heyitsme

heyitsme is a free digital business card and professional presence web product.

## Core jobs

- Create and edit one or more digital cards.
- Share a browser-first public card through a link or QR code.
- Pick a page template (Professional, Business or Services), reorder or hide sections, set an accent color, and add services with prices, opening hours, an address, highlights and one primary button.
- Let a recipient save or exchange contact details without installing an app.
- Keep a personal contact list with search and CSV export.
- Add an interactive photo carousel and visual gallery with expandable full-screen lightbox and image descriptions.
- Add a portfolio of images, videos, documents, and project links.
- Add social and direct communication channels including WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber, Signal, and Calendly.
- Publish approved comments from past clients as references.

## Phase-one routes

- `/` — marketing landing page.
- `/app` — overview workspace.
- `/app/cards` — card list.
- `/app/cards/new` — card builder.
- `/app/contacts` — contact list.
- `/app/insights` — views, saves, exchanges, and link taps per card.
- `/c/:slug` — public card, presented as a landing page in the owner's chosen template (photo, image or looping video cover, services and prices, hours and address, links, work, references, QR).
- `/c/demo?template=professional|business|services` — demo card in each template.
- `/privacy` — privacy policy.
- `/terms` — terms of use.

## Product rules

All implemented features are free for every signed-in user. heyitsme does not expose paid plans, checkout, billing, or upgrade gates. It does not sell NFC hardware and does not claim compliance certifications.
